title: Dirichlet Beta Analogues, Sign Alternation, and Lerch Unification of Hyperbolic and Logarithmic Tangent Integrals
summary: We develop a Dirichlet-beta counterpart and a structural extension of the coefficient-extraction framework for hyperbolic and logarithmic tangent integrals. For integers $m\geq n\geq1$ with $m+n$ even, the zeta-type formula \[ \int_0^\infty\frac{\tanh^{m+1}x}{x^{n+1}}\,dx = (-1)^{(m-n)/2} \sum_{p=\lceil n/2\rceil}^{(m+n)/2} \binom{2p}{n}(2^{2p+1}-1) \frac{ζ(2p+1)}{π^{2p}} [u^{m+n-2p}](u\cot u)^{m+1} \] admits the beta-type analogue \[ \int_0^\infty \frac{\tanh^m x}{x^n\cosh x}\,dx = (-1)^{(m-n)/2} \sum_{p=\lceil n/2\rceil}^{(m+n)/2} 2^{2p}\binom{2p-1}{n-1} \frac{β(2p)}{π^{2p-1}} [u^{m+n-2p}]…
